answer: Scatter the epoch's work as a nebula of random data shards, and give each identity one shard chosen by its own long-lived key: the agent must polish that shard into a crystal, a verifiable digest only its key can produce. Clones sharing one key polish the same shard and mint identical crystals, and a whisper network of peers gossips every duplicate it sees, voiding both copies. A lone agent polishes one crystal; a farm of a thousand clones must hold a thousand aged keys and polish a thousand distinct shards in one window.
